title: Dead load source
description: Woodcore-Datei/loads/dead/<id>.json -- one build-up of layers whose permanent load Woodcore computes (calc/domains/dead_load_source.py, docs/domain/loads.md §3.3ter, issue #35). Read beside the EL+AL-* sheets of a load workbook, under the same domain dead-load; an id both carry is refused.

schema_version.description: -- pinned. 1.1 (issue #42): 1.0 with `links`, written only where a field follows a variable.

id.description: The file name without .json, and the instance the report names: letters, digits and _ . + -.

group.description: Optional: the folder of Woodcore's list, "" for the root.

chosen.description: The permanent load designed with, kN/m², rounded up from the sum of the layers; null takes the sum.

kind.description: gk: Eigenlast (poids propre); ak: Auflast (surcharge) -- the engineer's choice for each layer.

library.description: Where the weight is read: SIA 261 Anhang A (Tabelle 28 or 29), Woodcore's materials library, the project's materials.json -- or direct, a load typed in kN/m² (`load`).

material.description: The line of the library: SIA 261's id, the workbook's material name (with its `ebene`), the project's id; for `direct`, the words the table prints.

ebene.description: The workbook's Ebene, which keys its library with the name.

thickness.description: In mm, above 0: what a weight per volume is multiplied by, and what the drawing stacks.

width.description: In mm: the width of battens, rafters or joists set at `spacing`; null for a continuous layer.

spacing.description: In mm: the spacing of those members, centre to centre; null for a continuous layer.

beside.description: true: the layer shares the band of the layer above it, drawn in its gaps (the insulation between the rafters).

load.description: For `direct`: the load typed, kN/m², above 0.

links.description: The fields of this entry that follow a variable of the export, by their key (thickness, width, spacing, load): the number the field holds is the last value known, which a variable that can no longer be read leaves in place with a warning (D-06). Absent where none follows one; only at schema_version 1.1.

.*.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).

links.description: The fields of this entry that follow a variable of the export, by their key (chosen): the number the field holds is the last value known, which a variable that can no longer be read leaves in place with a warning (D-06). Absent where none follows one; only at schema_version 1.1.

.*.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).
